crew.overview: When her mother disappears while on vacation in Colombia with her new boyfriend, June’s search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June creatively uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it’s too late. But as she digs deeper, her digital sleuthing raises more questions than answers... and when June unravels secrets about her mom, she discovers that she never really knew her at all.
crew.title: Missing

crew.overview: During a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside estate, a group of friends finds themselves entangled in a web of secrets, deception, and advanced technology. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, they uncover unsettling truths about themselves and the world around them.
crew.title: Companion

details.biography: Raphael Margules is an American filmmaker and co-founder of BoulderLight Pictures. He is best known for producing Contracted (2013), The Vigil (2019), Becky (2020), Barbarian (2022), Woman of the Hour (2023) and Companion (2025).
details.name: Raphael Margules
